app.title: YA-WAMF
app.tagline: AI-powered bird classification for your Frigate NVR

manual_observation.intro_title: Turn a photo or clip into a verified observation
manual_observation.intro_body: YA-WAMF uses the same model, crop selection, and video consensus as live detections. Nothing is added until you review it.

evidence.scored_help: This is the exact input the classifier scored.
evidence.original_help: Your original file, kept exactly as uploaded.

errors.load: The analysis status could not be loaded.

errors.video_size: Choose a video no larger than 250 MB.

upload.title: Choose a photo or video

analysis.title: Finding the strongest evidence

review.title: Review before saving

location.pin_label: Sighting location pin; drag to adjust

saved.title: Observation saved

bar.hint: Nothing is added until you review it

integrations.title: Integrations

history.title: Import existing detections

history.enable_help: Existing detections are updated only when classification quality improves; saved audio and weather context is preserved.

data.title: Data Management
data.maintenance_max_concurrent_help: Best practice is 1. Increase this only if you intentionally want backfill, taxonomy repair, timezone repair, or analyze-unknowns to overlap.
data.auto_cleanup_note: Automatic cleanup runs daily at 3 AM
data.cache_high_quality_event_snapshot_jpeg_q: Higher values keep more detail but create larger derived snapshot files.
data.diagnostics_desc: Open the Health tab for backend status, grouped incidents, and support bundles.
data.timezone_repair_desc: Validate older detection timestamps against Frigate and repair only safe whole-hour timezone offsets.
data.timezone_repair_note: This only updates detections when Frigate still has the matching event and the timestamp difference looks like a real timezone offset.
data.timezone_repair_preview_none: No safe timezone repairs were found.
data.timezone_repair_confirm: Apply safe timezone repairs to the previewed detections?
data.backfill_desc: Query Frigate history to fetch and classify past events.
data.backfill_validation_select_both: Select both start and end dates.
data.backfill_validation_order: Start date must be before or equal to end date.
data.batch_analysis_long_desc: Run video analysis on all detections labeled as "Unknown Bird". This will queue background tasks to download clips and re-classify them.
data.batch_analysis_circuit_open: Circuit Breaker Open (Paused due to failures)
data.cache_cleanup_success: Cache cleanup complete! Deleted {snapshots} snapshots, {clips} clips ({freed} freed).
data.cache_high_quality_event_snapshots_help: After an event ends, choose the clearest main-stream frame and best crop available. The full frame is kept when a reliable crop cannot be made.
data.cache_crop_detector_ready_help: Frigate tracking hints and the crop detectors are evaluated automatically.
data.cache_crop_fallback_ready_help: Frigate tracking hints are used automatically; detector crops join in when a model is installed.
data.frigate_missing_behavior: When Frigate no longer has the event/media
data.frigate_missing_behavior_mark: Mark missing and keep local data
data.frigate_missing_behavior_note: This policy is applied during manual scans and scheduled checks. Use mark-missing when YA-WAMF should keep detections longer than Frigate.
data.purge_missing_media_confirm: Scan detections whose Frigate event, clip, or snapshot is missing and apply the configured policy?
data.purge_missing_clips: Scan detections missing clips in Frigate
data.purge_missing_snapshots: Scan detections missing snapshots in Frigate
data.media_integrity_note: These scans apply the selected upstream-missing policy instead of always deleting detections.
data.purge_missing_clips_confirm: Scan detections whose clips are missing in Frigate and apply the configured policy?
data.purge_missing_snapshots_confirm: Scan detections whose snapshots are missing in Frigate and apply the configured policy?
data.purge_missing_scan_success: Scan complete: checked {checked}, missing {missing}, deleted {deleted}, marked missing {marked}, kept {kept}, restored {restored}.
data.clear_favorites_desc: Removes every favorite marker while keeping detections and media.
data.clear_favorites_confirm: Remove all favorite markers? This cannot be undone.

security.title: Security
security.https_warning: Security Warning: Authentication is enabled over HTTP. Your credentials may be exposed. Use HTTPS in production.

debug.title: Debug Tools
debug.subtitle: Extra switches for testing and diagnostics.
debug.model_eval_desc: Benchmark installed classifiers against taxonomy-verified bird images. Artifacts are stored under /config/yawamf-eval/.
debug.model_eval_action_desc: Run accuracy, latency, and sanity checks against every installed model. Owner-only.
debug.llm_prompts_subtitle: Customize the Markdown structure and tone for AI analysis and conversations.
debug.llm_prompt_style_help: Applies localized defaults for your current language.
debug.strict_non_finite_output_desc: When enabled, all-non-finite classifier outputs are rejected and trigger runtime recovery. Disable only for controlled debugging.

ai.clear_usage_confirm: Are you sure you want to clear AI usage history? This cannot be undone.
ai.provider_info_desc: YA-WAMF uses cloud LLMs for behavioral analysis and natural language interactions. You will need your own API key from the provider.
ai.prompts_subtitle: Customize the behavior of AI features
ai.pricing_help: Override the default token pricing for cost estimation. Format: an array of objects with provider, model, inputPer1M, and outputPer1M.
ai.test_subtitle: Checking the same multi-frame vision format used for detection analysis.
ai.test_configuration_ok: Provider, model, and credential are present.
ai.test_multiframe_ok: {count} JPEG frames were accepted in one request.
ai.test_skipped: Not run because an earlier stage failed.
ai.test_probe_note: This sends five representative 1280×720 JPEG frames, matching the count, dimensions, and approximate payload size of a real analysis request.
ai.test_network_error: The diagnostic request could not reach YA-WAMF.

birdnet.title: BirdNET-Go
birdnet.internal_url_help: Backend-only URL used to fetch spectrogram backgrounds, such as the Docker network address.
birdnet.external_url_help: Public HTTPS URL opened by dashboard links. Falls back to the internal URL when empty.
birdnet.audio_buffer_help: How long to keep audio detections for correlation (1-168 hours)
birdnet.match_window_help: Time window for matching audio with visual (±5-3600 seconds)
birdnet.sensor_mapping_empty: No cameras detected. Check Frigate connection.
birdnet.sensor_mapping_help: Map each Frigate camera to BirdNET source names (stable `nm` / display names). For multi-stream cameras, you can enter multiple names separated by commas.
birdnet.source_discovery_error: Failed to load recent BirdNET source names.
birdnet.source_discovery_empty: No BirdNET source names detected yet. Wait for audio detections, then reload Settings.
birdnet.source_discovery_help: Use these detected source names in the mapping fields above. Names are more stable than dynamic IDs across BirdNET-Go restarts.

inaturalist.title: iNaturalist
inaturalist.oauth_desc: Connect your iNaturalist account to submit verified detections.
inaturalist.app_owner_note: Requires iNaturalist App Owner approval (account 2+ months old and 10 improving IDs in the last month).
inaturalist.popup_blocked: The sign-in window was blocked. Allow popups for this site and try again.

ebird.title: eBird
ebird.api_key_desc: Required to fetch recent sightings and notable birds.
ebird.export_csv_desc: Download detections in eBird Record Format for manual import.
ebird.export_range_help: Leave both blank to export all detections, or choose an inclusive date range.
ebird.export_range_error: From date must be on or before the To date.
ebird.export_everything_label: Toggle export everything for eBird CSV
ebird.export_everything_help: Turn this on to export all detections and disable the date range.

birdweather.title: BirdWeather
birdweather.token_desc: Available in your station settings under "BirdWeather Token".

enrichment.title: Enrichment Sources
enrichment.desc: Sources are selected automatically based on your integrations.
enrichment.fallback_note: Fallbacks apply when a provider cannot supply a field. (eBird falls back to iNaturalist)

auth.title: Authentication
auth.desc: Require a login for full access.
auth.enable_desc: Protect settings and admin actions behind a login
auth.password_placeholder: Leave blank to keep current password
auth.proxy_trust_note: Proxy headers are trusted from all hosts by default. If you run behind a reverse proxy, set trusted proxy hosts to prevent spoofed client IPs.
auth.trusted_proxies_desc: Add your reverse proxy container names or IPs (e.g., nginx-rp, cloudflare-tunnel, 172.19.0.10). Docker DNS names work when services share a network.
auth.trusted_proxies_suggested_note: These are suggestions only. Save will keep the default (trust all) unless you accept or edit them.
auth.trusted_proxies_empty: No trusted proxies configured (all proxies trusted).

public_access.title: Public Access
public_access.enable_desc: Guests can view detections without logging in
public_access.show_camera_names_desc: Hide camera labels for public visitors
public_access.show_ai_conversation_desc: Allow guests to view AI chat threads on detections
public_access.allow_clip_downloads_desc: Allow guests to download full video clips
public_access.share_base_url_desc: If set, new share links use this public base URL instead of the detected request host.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Options
accessibility.dyslexia_font_desc: Use OpenDyslexic font for better readability
accessibility.zen_mode_desc: Simplify interface to reduce cognitive load
accessibility.live_announcements_desc: Announce new detections with screen reader alerts.

frigate.title: Frigate NVR
frigate.full_visit_clips_desc: Serve a longer clip window from Frigate recordings around each detection.
frigate.full_visit_supported: Continuous coverage is ready for all {count} selected camera(s).
frigate.full_visit_unavailable: Capability information is unavailable right now.
frigate.full_visit_reason_config_unavailable: Frigate config could not be read.
frigate.full_visit_reason_no_matching_cameras: No selected cameras match the current Frigate config.
frigate.full_visit_reason_recordings_disabled: Recording is disabled for the selected cameras. Enable recording and retain at least one continuous day.
frigate.full_visit_reason_continuous_retention_d: Frigate is not retaining a continuous timeline. Set record.continuous.days to at least 1; event-only clips can start late or end early.
frigate.full_visit_reason_record_stream_missing: A selected camera has no recording stream. Add record to its FFmpeg input roles and retain at least one continuous day.
frigate.full_visit_reason_camera_disabled: A selected camera is disabled in Frigate. Enable it before using full-visit clips.
frigate.full_visit_reason_camera_not_found: A selected camera is no longer present in Frigate. Sync the camera list and review your selection.
frigate.full_visit_reason_partial_camera_coverag: Only some selected cameras have continuous recording coverage. Full-visit clips stay unavailable until every selected camera is covered.
frigate.full_visit_reason_camera_configuration_i: The selected cameras have more than one recording configuration issue. Review each camera below.
frigate.full_visit_reason_retention_unknown: Continuous recording retention could not be determined. Validate the Frigate recording config before enabling full visits.

cameras.title: Active Cameras
cameras.preview_missing_url: No preview URL available for this camera.
cameras.nest_dedupe_help: Collapses repeat detections of the same species on a nest cam to one per N minutes.
cameras.role_feeder_help: Feeder cam — every Frigate event is treated as a fresh visit (default).
cameras.role_nest_help: Nest box cam — collapses repeat detections of the same species into one per dedupe window so a continuously-present nesting bird does not flood the feed.

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.desc: Optional, anonymous usage telemetry to help improve YA-WAMF. Disabled by default.
telemetry.privacy_notice: No images, clips, audio, detection content, usernames, emails, or API keys are collected.
telemetry.includes_value: Model type, enabled integrations, notification channels, enrichment mode, access flags
telemetry.geography_value: Approx. country derived from request headers (IP not stored)
telemetry.health_desc: Share deduped backend health issues once per day so recurring failures can be debugged.
telemetry.health_includes_value: Issue fingerprints, component/reason codes, severity, counts, coarse runtime settings, and sanitized context
telemetry.appreciation_tooltip: If you can, please enable telemetry. It helps me understand how YA-WAMF is used and guides improvements.

email.title: Email Notifications
email.desc: Send email alerts for bird detections
email.oauth_desc: Secure authentication using Gmail or Outlook
email.oauth_instructions: Click the button to authorize YA-WAMF to send emails on your behalf. You'll be redirected to {provider} to sign in.
email.only_on_end_desc: Send email notifications only when Frigate publishes the end event (treated as an update).
email.dashboard_url_desc: Link to your dashboard in email notifications
email.credentials_required: Please configure OAuth or SMTP credentials first
email.oauth_app_credentials_desc: Your Google or Microsoft OAuth app credentials, required before connecting an account.

notifications.audio_only_desc: Only alert when BirdNET audio confirms the detection.
notifications.mode_desc: Pick how and when notifications are sent. Advanced lets you override the exact triggers.
notifications.mode_final_desc: Notify only when the event ends and video analysis (if enabled) is complete.
notifications.mode_standard_desc: Notify when a confirmed detection is created.
notifications.mode_realtime_desc: Notify early and allow update notifications as the detection evolves.
notifications.notify_on_insert_desc: Send notifications only when a new detection is created.
notifications.notify_on_update_desc: Send notifications when detections are updated (higher score or audio confirmed).
notifications.confirmation_policy: Notifications are only sent when a snapshot is confirmed (confidence threshold or audio confirmation) or when video analysis confirms the detection.
notifications.delay_until_video_desc: Wait for auto video analysis before notifying. YA-WAMF automatically uses the video pipeline timing as the minimum wait.
notifications.video_fallback_timeout_desc: Optional extra wait time. YA-WAMF will never wait less than the auto-derived video pipeline minimum.
notifications.cooldown_desc: Minimum time between notifications in minutes (0 to disable).
notifications.enable_notify_hint: Notifications are currently off. Enable "Notify on new detections" or "Notify on updates" to send any alerts.
notifications.species_filter_none_desc: Notify for all species that pass the other filters.
notifications.species_filter_blacklist_desc: Notify for everything except the species below.
notifications.species_filter_whitelist_desc: Notify only for the species below.
notifications.species_filter_blacklist_list: Do not notify for these species
notifications.species_filter_search_placeholder: Search birds by common or scientific name
notifications.notification_language_desc: Language used for the text of notification messages sent to all channels

pushover.title: Pushover Notifications
pushover.device_hint: Comma-separated device names. Leave blank to send to all active devices.

location.title: Location
location.weather_unit_system_desc: Use one consistent unit system for temperature, wind, and precipitation.
location.desc: Used for localized weather context during detections.
location.map_empty: No coordinates configured yet — set a latitude and longitude (or enable auto-detect) to see the map.
location.map_help: Showing the location currently configured for weather, hotspots, and observations.
location.mode_help: Auto-detect uses your IP/timezone. Manual lets you pin exact coordinates for weather, eBird hotspots, and observation submissions.
location.resolve_empty: No place name available for these coordinates

danger.title: Danger Zone
danger.subtitle: Destructive actions
danger.reset_desc: Resetting the database will permanently delete ALL detections and clear the media cache. This action cannot be undone.
danger.confirm: DANGER: This will delete ALL detections and clear the media cache. This action cannot be undone. Are you sure?
danger.clear_feedback_desc: Clearing personalization feedback will delete all manual tag corrections the AI uses to adjust confidence scores. This will revert the classifier to its baseline accuracy.
danger.clear_feedback_hint: This does not delete detections or media. Re-ranking will begin learning again as you make new manual corrections.
danger.clear_feedback_confirm: Are you sure you want to clear all personalized re-ranking data? This will revert the AI back to its baseline accuracy and cannot be undone.

detection.floor_help: Events below this floor are ignored completely. Events between floor and threshold are saved as "Unknown Bird".
detection.trust_frigate_desc: Skip internal classification if Frigate identified species
detection.write_frigate_sublabel_desc: Append YA-WAMF species labels to Frigate event sublabels
detection.auto_video_desc: Automatically run deep video reclassification for every event
detection.video_retry_note: Retries use exponential backoff to wait for Frigate clip finalization.
detection.cuda_desc: Use NVIDIA GPU for faster ONNX model inference (ConvNeXt, EVA-02)
detection.cuda_not_supported: Your environment does not support CUDA or onnxruntime-gpu is missing.
detection.naming_scientific_sub: Only show scientific names. Hides common names.
detection.blocked_species_picker_desc: Search for a species or other taxon to block it reliably across common-name, scientific-name, and taxonomy-aware matches. Cached detections and legacy raw labels still apply until you remove them.
detection.inference_provider_desc: Only providers included in this image, detected on this host, and supported by the active model are shown.
detection.provider_saved_unavailable: {provider} is saved but is not available in this image, on this host, or for the active model. Choose an available provider or Auto.
detection.execution_mode_desc: In-Process uses much less RAM by sharing model weights, especially with larger models. Subprocess provides stronger isolation and stability, but uses significantly more memory.
detection.model_lineup_description: Recommended models are ordered first and fit the broadest range of hardware and feeders.
detection.model_lineup_advanced_note: Advanced models are hidden by default because they usually need more RAM, run slower, or cover broader wildlife taxonomies than most installs need.
detection.region_override_desc: Auto uses your configured country. Manual override always wins.
detection.personalized_rerank_desc: Use manual tags to adapt ranking per camera and model. Disable to use base model scores only.
detection.video_concurrency_best_practice_in_proce: In-Process mode shares one backend runtime. Best practice is to keep video concurrency at 1 unless you have verified your model runtime stays stable under overlap.
detection.video_concurrency_best_practice_subproce: Subprocess mode isolates classifier workers more strongly, but raising video concurrency still increases CPU, RAM, and GPU pressure.
detection.cuda_runtime_only: CUDA runtime installed (no NVIDIA GPU detected)
detection.model_manager_subtitle: Recommended models are shown by default. Lower-performing and niche options are hidden until you need them.
detection.model_manager_crop_policy_automatic_desc: YA-WAMF uses the crop policy tested for this model. There is nothing to tune when you switch models.
detection.model_manager_thumbnail_crop_desc: YA-WAMF evaluates the accurate detector, fast fallback, and Frigate tracking hints automatically; the clear full frame is used only if none yields a reliable crop.
detection.model_manager_lineup_desc: Recommended models are shown first. Lower-performing and niche options are collapsed below.
detection.model_manager_advanced_hidden: Legacy and lower-performing models are hidden. Use "Show all models" to see every option.
detection.model_manager_host_verification: OpenVINO host verification is shown for the active ONNX model.
detection.model_manager_threshold_hint: Recommended confidence threshold for this model:
detection.model_manager_install_subtitle: Download, validate on your hardware, and enable this model.
detection.model_manager_install_note: Each step runs on your hardware. Nothing becomes active until validation passes.
detection.model_manager_device_set: Fastest verified provider: {provider}{ms} — it will be applied when this model is enabled.
detection.model_manager_validation_needed: Downloaded but not yet validated on your hardware. Validate it to confirm it runs here before you select it.
detection.model_manager_validate_subtitle: Confirm this model runs on your hardware, then enable it for selection.
detection.model_manager_validate_note: Validation trial-loads the model and runs one frame through it, then restores your current model.
detection.model_manager_validate_ran_ok: Ran on {provider}{ms} and produced valid output.
detection.model_manager_provider_cuda_available_ti: CUDA provider is available on this host
detection.model_manager_provider_cuda_unavailable_: CUDA provider is not available on this host
detection.model_manager_provider_openvino_cpu_fall: OpenVINO CPU compile failed and fallback is active
detection.model_manager_provider_openvino_cpu_avai: OpenVINO CPU is available on this host
detection.model_manager_provider_openvino_cpu_unav: OpenVINO CPU is not available on this host
detection.model_manager_provider_openvino_gpu_fall: OpenVINO GPU compile failed and fallback is active
detection.model_manager_provider_openvino_gpu_avai: OpenVINO GPU is available on this host
detection.model_manager_provider_openvino_gpu_unav: OpenVINO GPU is not available on this host
detection.model_manager_provider_fallback_title: Automatic fallback in the order shown
detection.openvino_compile_failure: OpenVINO model incompatibility on this host
detection.openvino_compile_failure_detail: This model cannot compile on the currently selected OpenVINO device. YA-WAMF will keep the model installed but run inference on {fallback}.
detection.crop_priority_desc: Which crop source is tried first. Each option falls back to the next and finally to the full frame, so a bird crop is used whenever one can be produced, even a small one. The selected crop detector tier is respected whenever the model path is used.
detection.crop_tier_desc: Fast keeps the current SSD detector as the default. Accurate uses the experimental YOLOX-Tiny tier and falls back to fast automatically when it is unavailable.
detection.image_flavor_mismatch: The {provider} runtime is not included in the {flavor} image. Use the full image or a matching provider image, then recreate the container. CPU fallback remains available.
detection.compat_unverified: Not yet run on this host — run the check to verify the providers available in this image.
detection.compat_test_subtitle: Validates every provider available to this image and model against the CPU baseline.

llm.title: AI Insights
llm.test_hint: Runs a quick prompt to verify your API key and model.
llm.model_hint: Choose a model that supports image input (vision). Text-only models will fail analysis.
llm.openrouter_model_hint: Enter any OpenRouter model ID (e.g. google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite). Browse models at openrouter.ai/models.

auth.signin_desc: Sign in to manage your feeder
auth.loading_status_desc: Checking the service and your access settings before opening the feeder.
auth.startup_status_desc: Model loading and hardware checks can take longer after an update or model change. This progress comes directly from the container.

auth.startup_phase_loading_model: Loading and checking the selected bird model
auth.startup_phase_model_unavailable: Classifier unavailable — setup can continue after the backend starts
auth.status_unavailable_desc: The service may still be starting after an update or model change. Your feeder data is safe while it comes back online.
auth.status_unavailable_auto_retry: YA-WAMF checks again automatically every five seconds.
auth.status_unavailable_help: If it stays offline, check the container health and startup logs.

notifications.live_updates_disconnected_message: Live updates are reconnecting in the background.
notifications.system_cache_disabled_message: Timeline previews and media caching are disabled in current settings.

detection.audio_context_suppressed: Nearby audio was heard, but on a microphone this camera is not mapped to. Change the sensor mapping in Settings to include it.

causes.event_missing_retention: Frigate removed or no longer retained the event before follow-up checks completed.
causes.event_missing_restart: Frigate restarted or its database state changed, so this event id is no longer present.
causes.clip_retention: Clip retention window expired before video analysis ran.
causes.clip_policy: Recording policy may keep snapshots/events but not clips for this camera.
causes.clip_pending: Frigate had not finished clip generation when video analysis attempted retrieval.
causes.clip_removed: Clip was removed or never written even though the event was detected.
causes.clip_corrupt: Clip bytes were incomplete/corrupted or not a valid playable media file.
causes.transcode_issue: Frigate/ffmpeg encoding output may be incompatible or interrupted.
causes.timeout_load: Frigate was slow or overloaded while event/clip metadata was requested.
causes.timeout_network: Temporary network or reverse-proxy latency caused request timeout.
causes.frigate_unreachable: Frigate API could not be reached from YA-WAMF at this moment.
causes.frigate_http_error: Frigate or reverse proxy returned a non-success HTTP response.
causes.video_timeout_large_clip: Clip processing took longer than configured timeout.
causes.video_timeout_resource: GPU/CPU resources were saturated while running inference.
causes.no_results_frames: One or more image sources did not produce enough confident, matching frame predictions.
causes.no_results_quality: The bird may be visible while wet plumage, motion, distance, occlusion, or crop instability still makes species evidence inconsistent.
causes.pipeline_guard: Safety guard/circuit breaker paused background video jobs after repeated failures.
causes.pipeline_exception: A runtime exception or cancellation interrupted the classification task.
causes.unknown_1: An unexpected error occurred in media retrieval or video processing.
causes.unknown_2: The event state changed while analysis was in progress.

about.flaticon_credit: Bird icons created by Freepik - Flaticon
about.built_with_ai: Built with AI assistance for the love of bird watching 🐦
about.project_desc_1: YA-WAMF is a personal project started to experiment with AI-assisted coding. When the original {link} project became unmaintained, this was born as both a learning opportunity and a useful tool for bird enthusiasts.
about.project_desc_2: Frigate watches the feeder and flags anything that looks like a bird. YA-WAMF classifies it, checks it against BirdNET-Go audio, and stores the result. Every photo on this page came off that camera.

The Arctic Tern migrates over 44,000 miles annually - the longest migration of any bird
Owls cannot move their eyeballs, which is why they can rotate their heads up to 270 degrees

Ravens can imitate human speech and other sounds like car engines and toilets flushing
Penguins propose to their mates with a pebble
Blue jays can mimic the calls of hawks to scare other birds away from feeders
A bird's feathers weigh more than its skeleton
The Bee Hummingbird is the smallest bird in the world, weighing less than a penny
Frigatebirds can stay in the air for months at a time without landing
Magpies are one of the few animals that can recognize themselves in a mirror
The wandering albatross has the largest wingspan of any living bird, up to 11.8 feet
Woodpeckers don't get headaches because their skulls have air pockets to absorb shock
Swifts spend most of their lives in the air and can even sleep while flying
Birds aren't real - they're government surveillance drones (allegedly)
Geese have teeth on their tongues. Sleep well tonight!
